history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-24, as the re-pin of the #744 pilots to track-p c5501d3c (#1149 merged there; the d96cc8de gates passed with every arm exercised: normal world ship 15, m1135 11, nogate 11 of 18 plays differing from pre1134; poison-x8 ship 17, m1135 14, nogate 14, 0 deaths anywhere). Four arms on c5501d3c (the normal world): pre1134 (all dear-cure rows 0, the play before #1134), ship (PR #1149 as shipped: neutralize 2 at 40 percent, ccw 2 at 112 percent, dear_after_recall 1), nogate (ship with dear_after_recall 0), m1135 (what track-p ships after #1135: shared poison row at 40, neutralize 0, ccw 2 at 112, dear_after_recall 0). Pilot tier: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, evidence retained.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (an arm that plays pre1134's keys was not exercised). Report per arm and per class: purchases per game of Cure Critical Wounds and Neutralize Poison, and of the staples as a guard (Word of Recall, Cure Light Wounds, Cure Serious Wounds, Phase Door, flasks of oil, light, food), deaths and deaths by poison, gold at death, CL and depth at death, Recall carried when leaving town past DL2. Descriptive (RULES 14).
